video_title: Mad Max Unfiltered: Wildest Moments On ALL THE SMOKE

quotes.speaker: Vernon Maxwell
quotes.summary_phrase: Vernon Maxwell on his intense, physical rivalry with Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: I don't think he was ready for this damn grown man shit.
quotes.quote: Kobe, shit. When I, I hate to tell this story. God bless you, Kobe. Kobe, he was in high school, his senior year. I was with the Sixers back in 95, 96, something like that. He was in high school with the Sixers, and John Lucas brought him in to practice with us and shit. So I was like, damn, he got this young motherfucker. I had seen him. I saw him over there at Lower Merion playing and shit. I'm watching him on TV, and I'm watching him play. I'm like, yeah, he's tough. But damn, I don't think he was ready for this damn grown man shit. That's what I thought when he walked in that motherfucking gym.

quotes.speaker: Vernon Maxwell
quotes.summary_phrase: Vernon Maxwell on guarding Kobe Bryant in practice
quotes.excerpt: I'm guarding Kobe, shit. I'm a two-in-here, too.
quotes.quote: So we started to plan, and he was playing, and you know, and I think it was me and Jerry Stackhouse. We're on the starting team with the Sixers, and Kobe, they stole Kobe on the second team and shit. And I'm, you know, I'm guarding Kobe, shit. I'm a two-in-here, too. So, shit, that motherfucker came at me. I got, I got, I got. I pulled up on him. I said, oh my goodness, okay. Just a little motherfucker for real. I said, this motherfucker, yeah, I said, so I got to really strap up and you know, check this motherfucker.

quotes.speaker: Vernon Maxwell
quotes.summary_phrase: Vernon Maxwell on his physical defense against Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: He started putting my last in that post and start talking and doing all that.
quotes.quote: So then I got damn, I tried to get physical with this motherfucker. And why did I do that? This motherfucker, he started putting my last in that post and start talking and doing all that. I said, this motherfucker played just like Mike. And this, I mean, this when he was in high school. This motherfucker was tough, man. He was, he was so tough, man. And then he started coming downhill at me. And man, it was unbelievable. I couldn't do nothing with this motherfucker, man. And but back then, he wasn't talking shit. He was just, he was just killing niggers. He was just killing.

quotes.speaker: Vernon Maxwell
quotes.summary_phrase: Vernon Maxwell on Magic Johnson's reaction to his defense
quotes.excerpt: When are you going to guard this motherfucker, man?
quotes.quote: He came down and gave me probably about 12 straight, and John Lucas stopped and called timeout and asked me, "Man, when are you going to guard this motherfucker, man? When are you going to start guarding this motherfucker? This man, goddamn, he need to get his ass." So that's when I told Kobe, "Bean" Bryant, I said, "Kobe, I want to tell you something, son. I said, man, don't you touch no motherfucking college floor. Man, you come on, goddamn, this is the league, man. You ready, man. Don't you touch no college. I'm one of the better defenders in this motherfucker. And the way you did me today, man, I know I'm probably playing, but you are a motherfucker. Come on, man, come on to get your money, man."

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson and Vernon Maxwell on trash-talking Magic Johnson
quotes.excerpt: Maxwell said he could guard him. Out loud.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: Another story I literally just heard the other day, Magic Johnson went on Byron Scott's podcast, talking about when you called out Magic. Do you remember when that happened?

text_blocks.speaker: Vernon Maxwell
text_blocks.text: Yeah, see, I saw that shit, Byron.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: I remember when Maxwell was on you. Maxwell said he could guard him. Out loud. Out loud. So me and Coop said, "Buck, did you hear what he just said?" And he started sky-hooking Max's ass to death, right? And you know me and Coop, "Buck, that's what we talking about. Kill his ass. He can't guard you, Buck."

text_blocks.speaker: Vernon Maxwell
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I remember that. Absolutely. When I, in the league, and he gave us a, a whole speech. Remember that whole speech? Remember when y'all in the jungles? Y'all had your spears and shit.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: That shit, coach said that? Paul Westphal? Yeah, he's trying to motivate us. He wanted like a 4-4.

text_blocks.speaker: Vernon Maxwell
text_blocks.text: No, no. Me and him were the only ones that reacted like, "Ooh."
